shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Shallow shadow under the dark preview.

shadows.name: controls
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for the white control panel.

motion.name: button-color
motion.purpose: Background, border, and text state changes.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Scale to 0.98 on active; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Add to basket
components.description: Orange purchase action beneath the project summary.
components.css: .ds-cart{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:213px;min-height:49px;border:1px solid #c54b1c;border-radius:6px;background:#c54b1c;padding:13px 20px;color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-cart:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#ae3e14;background:#ae3e14}.ds-cart:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e45c22 55%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-cart:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.98)}.ds-cart:disabled{border-color:#dae2cc;background:#e6eddc;color:#73815f;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cart{transition:none}.ds-cart:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;border:1px solid #d9dbd2;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;padding:9px 14px;color:#474940;font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:#bfc5b1;background:#ebeede}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e45c22 55%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}.ds-secondary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Dimension field
components.description: Labeled numeric input with tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field>span{color:#626857;font-size:12px;font-weight:450;line-height:1.35}.ds-field input{min-width:0;min-height:46px;border:1px solid #dedfd6;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;padding:10px 12px;color:#33362c;font:inherit;font-size:15px;font-weight:550;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.45;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,34,18,.02)}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:#e45c22}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e45c22 55%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Control tabs
components.description: Flat, iconless specimen of the existing underline selection pattern.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Параметры"><button class="ds-selected" type="button" aria-current="page">Надпись</button><button type="button">Цвета</button><button type="button">Свет</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5dd;padding:0 10px;font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-tabs button{position:relative;min-height:61px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:8px 2px 11px;color:#626857;font:inherit;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:rgba(226,231,215,.35);color:#566046}.ds-tabs .ds-selected{color:#b74719}.ds-tabs .ds-selected:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:-1px;left:8px;height:2px;background:#e45c22}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e45c22 55%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Basket count
components.description: Passive compact quantity badge in the header basket action.

components.name: Control panel
components.description: White bordered panel with a quiet heading and explanatory note.

components.name: View switch
components.description: 2D/3D selection on the dark workspace toolbar.
components.css: .ds-view{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;border:1px solid #4b5242;border-radius:5px;background:#24291f;padding:3px;font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-view button{min-width:49px;min-height:31px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;padding:4px 10px;color:#b4beaa;font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease}.ds-view button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#e5ebda;color:#353d2c}.ds-view button:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){background:#39452e;color:#fff}.ds-view button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e45c22 55%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-view button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The current studio uses a cream page, white controls, olive neutrals, and orange actions. Its dark preview is the visual center: lettering, material depth, dimensions, and illumination carry the expression while the interface stays compact and practical. Preserve the existing Веркуп mark and Russian interface.

This records the built public studio, not a new identity or a rule for unrelated CRM screens. Ground truth is `src/sign-studio.css`, `src/sign-studio-commerce.css`, `src/sign-cart.css`, `src/sign-scene-3d.css`, and the matching components. Current captures are in `.impeccable/review/` at desktop, mobile, and the actual 489px viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and olive working surfaces with restrained orange emphasis.
Dark preview beside a white, sectioned control panel.
Small labels, thin dividers, and tabular dimensions and prices.
dos: Do preserve the cream, olive, orange, and Manrope identity when extending the studio.
Do keep controls readable around the preview and retain units, selection states, focus feedback, and approval notes.
Do check the desktop layout and narrow mobile layout together after changing the shared surface.
donts: Don't turn scene glow or user-selected material colors into decorative UI effects.
Don't replace the compact borders, small radii, and underlined tabs with a new component style.
Don't label a locally saved basket as a submitted order or visually fold unpriced work into the calculated total.
